archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & MOODY ESPRESSO BAR WITH WARM MINIMALISM AND MODERN INDIAN RESTRAINT
concept: SARAI (सराय — historically a sanctuary and caravan resting house for ancient travellers along the Grand Trunk Road and spice routes). Fused into a hyper-modern, award-winning specialty coffee atelier spotlighting single-origin Indian microlots (Chikmagalur, Araku Valley, Monsooned Malabar, Coorg) brewed with sculptural precision (Brass South Indian Kaapi Syphon, Nitro Pour-over, Smoked Jaggery Espresso, Cardamom Husk Cold Brew).

design_dna.vibe_fusion: Warm Minimalist architecture + Dark & Moody night espresso bar + Bold modern typographic tension
design_dna.inspiration_level: Awwwards Site of the Day / Godly.website level. Zero AI-slop: NO purple gradients, NO centered Inter cards, NO generic stock photo boxes, NO default bootstrap columns
design_dna.visual_texture: Subtle film grain / noise overlay, warm obsidian (#0C0A09), terracotta/burnt ochre accents (#D97706 / #C2410C / #E0A96D), brass & raw linen, hairline borders with 10-15% opacity, and masked line-by-line editorial reveals

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lenis' or use custom smooth scroll provider so the landing page has weighted, award-winning momentum.
Add Google Fonts link in public/index.html with Cormorant Garamond, Plus Jakarta Sans, Playfair Display, and Space Mono.
Ensure dark theme is primary default (deep obsidian #0B0908, with amber #E0A96D and brass #C89D5C accents). Never flash unstyled white.
Do NOT use generic Inter or purple gradients anywhere. All borders must be subtle brass hairlines (border-amber-900/30 or border-stone-800).
All prices must be in Indian Rupees (₹) with authentic specialty coffee pricing (₹240 to ₹450).
Implement the 'Ask Sarai' AI chat widget with rich mocked responses for flavor profiles, bean origin info, and pairing advice, with code structure cleanly prepared for OpenRouter API keys.
Ensure 100% responsiveness on mobile (menu drawer, stacked hero, sticky mobile bar, touch-friendly tabs).
Verify all interactive buttons, inputs, and tabs have their specified data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. 'transition: all'). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts the natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Use sonner for toasts (already installed in package.json).
